newsitem.title: USA: Pa. says March revenues $101 mln above expectation.
newsitem.headline: Pa. says March revenues $101 mln above expectation.

text.p: Pennsylvania collected $2.5 billion in taxes during March, $100.5 million or 4.2 percent more than official expectations, the state's Revenue Department said.
Year-to-date collections are $369.7 million, or 3.1 percent, above estimate at $12.4 billion.
The state said collections were above estimate for all major tax categories during March.
Total sales and use tax collections totaled $447.8 million for the month. Collections for the fiscal year are $154.1 million, or 3.5 percent, above estimate.
Total personal income tax collections were $31.1 million, or 8.1 percent, above estimate for the month.

Motor License Fund collections of $127 million in March were $5.4 million, or 4.1 percent, below the official estimate, but year-to-date collections were above estimate by $21.5 million, or 1.9 percent.
